U.description: UP face CLOCKWISE 90°        (top face, turn right)

U'.description: UP face COUNTER-CLOCKWISE 90° (top face, turn left)

D.description: DOWN face CLOCKWISE 90°       (bottom face, turn right when viewed from below)

F.description: FRONT face CLOCKWISE 90°      (Green face toward you, turn right)

B.description: BACK face CLOCKWISE 90°       (Blue face away from you, turn right from back)

R.description: RIGHT face CLOCKWISE 90°      (Red face on right, turn down)

L.description: LEFT face CLOCKWISE 90°       (Orange face on left, turn down)
